_comment: The summit car park on the pass: Touge Nights' meeting spot (the diner of the setting, diner.json) and the Cruise
screen's place. street.kn5 and ground.bin are written by tools/TougeScene (build_spot.py: compose_spot.py in Blender,
then prepare_prop.py and the diner's DinerSceneBuilder). One model for every light of the day, with a sky dome each.
Positions are metres, x along the pass (east) and z across it: the origin is the middle of the road in front of the
car park, which lies north of it (towards -z), from z = -3.5 (the road's edge) to the guardrail at z = -34.6; past the
rail the ground falls away to the valley. Headings are degrees about the vertical, 0 facing +z (the road), 90 east.
player: where the Cruise screen parks the player's car: in the car park's mouth by the road, facing west, the road
out of its left window. laneOffset, rivalStop, approachFrom, leaveTo: the rivals' lane (see docs/modding.md, streets).
sun, lights, glow: as Main Street's; the night's lamps are the lamp posts round the lot and the vending machines' glow.
title: The Summit
credit: A car park on a mountain pass, ours, set with 23 Sketchfab models by adenotoxin, spookyghostboo, erikkinc, lolipop_1707, kmb_jr, andereberna, naprimerjenya, Nick.Stark, sahirvirmani, Derik_Nicolas, Hiushiko, ditovirnantio, reckzilla, Daniel Zhabotinsky, all CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), scaled, decimated, set into the car park and converted to KN5 (each named with its page and changes in this folder's CREDITS.txt); textures and skies by Poly Haven (CC0)
